select fu.FUNDSUSEID, fu.PARTYCODE,z.DZZMC as PARTYNAME, fu.HANDLEUSERID, fu.HANDLEUSERNAME,fu.EXPENDTIME, fu.EXPENDMONEY, fu.EXPENDSCOPE, fu.EXPENDTYPE, fu.CREATETIME, fu.CREATEUSERID, fu.CREATEUSERNAME, fu.UPDATETIME, fu.UPDATEUSERID, fu.UPDATEUSERNAME, fu.OPERATETIME, fu.OPERATESTATE, fu.SYNCSTATE from DJ_FUNDSUSE fu inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX z on fu.partycode=z.dzzdm where 1=1
and z.DZZMC like concat('%',#{dzzmc},'%')
and fu.partyCode like concat('%',#{partyCode},'%')
and fu.EXPENDTIME >= date_format(#{beginTime},"%Y%m%d")
and fu.EXPENDTIME < date_add(date_format(#{endTime},'%Y%m%d'),interval 1 day)
and fu.EXPENDSCOPE=#{expendScope}
and fu.EXPENDTYPE=#{expendType}
order by fu.CREATETIME desc

select *from ( select zz.DZZDM PARTYCODE,zz.DZZMC, ut.奖励经费 奖励经费,ut.活动经费 活动经费,ut.总预算 总预算, ur.奖励支出/10000 奖励支出,ur.活动支出/10000 活动支出,ur.总支出/10000 总支出, case ur.总支出 when 0 then '0.00' ELSE round((ur.奖励支出/ur.总支出),4)*100 END 奖励支出占比, case ur.总支出 when 0 then '0.00' ELSE round((ur.活动支出/ur.总支出),4)*100 END 活动支出占比 from ZZ_ZZQKXX zz inner join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB fb on zz.DZZDM=fb.DZZDM left join ( select z.DZZDM, ifnull(sum(u.活动经费), 0) 活动经费, ifnull(sum(u.奖励经费), 0) 奖励经费, (ifnull(sum(u.奖励经费), 0)+ ifnull(sum(u.活动经费), 0)) 总预算 from ZZ_ZZQKXX z left join( select PARTYCODE,sum(ifnull(ACTIVITYFUNDS, 0)) 活动经费,sum(ifnull(REWARDFUNDS, 0)) 奖励经费 from DJ_FUNDSBUDGET budget where year = #{year} group by budget.PARTYCODE ) u on z.DZZDM = substr(u.PARTYCODE, 1, length(z.DZZDM)) group by z.DZZDM )ut on zz.DZZDM=ut.DZZDM left join ( select z.DZZDM, ifnull(sum(u.活动经费),0) 活动支出, ifnull(sum(u.奖励经费),0) 奖励支出, (ifnull(sum(u.奖励经费),0)+ifnull(sum(u.活动经费),0)) 总支出 from ZZ_ZZQKXX z left join( select PARTYCODE, sum(case EXPENDSCOPE when 1 then EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END) as 活动经费, sum(case EXPENDSCOPE when 2 then EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END) as 奖励经费 from DJ_FUNDSUSE where extract(year from EXPENDTIME) = #{year} group by PARTYCODE )u on z.DZZDM=substr(u.PARTYCODE, 1, length(z.DZZDM)) group by z.DZZDM )ur on zz.DZZDM=ur.DZZDM where fb.ZZLB in('100','200','300','400') and zz.DZZDM like '001091209%'
and fb.ZZLB in('100','200')
and zz.DZZDM like concat('%',#{partyCode},'%')
and zz.DZZMC like concat('%',#{dzzmc},'%')
order by SUBSTR(zz.DZZDM,1,LENGTH(zz.DZZDM)-3),zz.DZZDM ) tb where 1=1
and tb.PARTYCODE =#{DZZDM}

select zz.DZZDM PARTYCODE,zz.DZZMC, ut.奖励经费 奖励经费,ut.活动经费 活动经费,ut.总预算 总预算, ur.*,(ur.奖励支出+ur.活动支出) 总支出, (CASE (ur.奖励支出+ur.活动支出) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE round((ur.奖励支出/(ur.奖励支出+ur.活动支出)),2)*100 END) 奖励支出占比, (CASE (ur.奖励支出+ur.活动支出) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE round((ur.活动支出/(ur.奖励支出+ur.活动支出)),2)*100 END) 活动支出占比, (CASE ur.活动支出 WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE round((ur.学习教育活动/ur.活动支出),2)*100 END) 学习教育活动占比, (CASE ur.活动支出 WHEN 0 END) 会议活动占比, (CASE ur.活动支出 WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE round((ur.党建日常工作/ur.活动支出),2)*100 END) 党建日常工作占比, (CASE ur.活动支出 WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE round((ur.走访慰问活动/ur.活动支出),2)*100 END) 走访慰问活动占比, (CASE ur.活动支出 WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE round((ur.设备设施/ur.活动支出),2)*100 END) 设备设施占比, (CASE ur.活动支出 WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE round((ur.其他/ur.活动支出),2)*100 END) 其他占比, (CASE ur.奖励支出 WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE round((ur.综合考评奖励/ur.奖励支出),2)*100 END) 综合考评奖励占比, (CASE ur.奖励支出 WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE round((ur.七一表彰奖励/ur.奖励支出),2)*100 END) 七一表彰奖励占比, (CASE ur.奖励支出 WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE round((ur.创岗建区表彰奖励/ur.奖励支出),2)*100 END) 创岗建区表彰奖励占比, (CASE ur.奖励支出 WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE round((ur.党建工作成果奖励/ur.奖励支出),2)*100 END) 党建工作成果奖励占比, (CASE ur.奖励支出 WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE round((ur.主题竞赛活动奖励/ur.奖励支出),2)*100 END) 主题竞赛活动奖励占比 from ZZ_ZZQKXX zz inner join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB fb on zz.DZZDM=fb.DZZDM left join ( select z.DZZDM, ifnull(sum(u.活动经费), 0) 活动经费, ifnull(sum(u.奖励经费), 0) 奖励经费, (ifnull(sum(u.奖励经费), 0)+ ifnull(sum(u.活动经费), 0)) 总预算 from ZZ_ZZQKXX z left join( select PARTYCODE,sum(ifnull(ACTIVITYFUNDS, 0)) 活动经费,sum(ifnull(REWARDFUNDS, 0)) 奖励经费 from DJ_FUNDSBUDGET budget where year = #{year} group by budget.PARTYCODE ) u on z.DZZDM = substr(u.PARTYCODE, 1, length(z.DZZDM)) group by z.DZZDM )ut on zz.DZZDM=ut.DZZDM left join ( select z.DZZDM, ifnull(sum(u.学习教育活动),0)/10000 学习教育活动, ifnull(sum(u.党内主题活动),0)/10000 党内主题活动, ifnull(sum(u.宣传活动),0)/10000 宣传活动, ifnull(sum(u.会议活动),0)/10000 会议活动, ifnull(sum(u.党建日常工作),0)/10000 党建日常工作, ifnull(sum(u.走访慰问活动),0)/10000 走访慰问活动, ifnull(sum(u.设备设施),0)/10000 设备设施, ifnull(sum(u.其他),0)/10000 其他, ifnull(sum(u.综合考评奖励),0)/10000 综合考评奖励, ifnull(sum(u.七一表彰奖励),0)/10000 七一表彰奖励, ifnull(sum(u.创岗建区表彰奖励),0)/10000 创岗建区表彰奖励, ifnull(sum(u.党建工作成果奖励),0)/10000 党建工作成果奖励, ifnull(sum(u.主题竞赛活动奖励),0)/10000 主题竞赛活动奖励, (ifnull(sum(u.学习教育活动),0)+ifnull(sum(u.党内主题活动),0)+ ifnull(sum(u.宣传活动),0)+ ifnull(sum(u.会议活动),0)+ ifnull(sum(u.党建日常工作),0)+ ifnull(sum(u.走访慰问活动),0)+ ifnull(sum(u.设备设施),0)+ ifnull(sum(u.其他),0))/10000 活动支出, (ifnull(sum(u.综合考评奖励),0)+ifnull(sum(u.七一表彰奖励),0)+ifnull(sum(u.创岗建区表彰奖励),0)+ifnull(sum(u.党建工作成果奖励),0)+ifnull(sum(u.主题竞赛活动奖励),0))/10000 奖励支出
from ZZ_ZZQKXX z left join( select PARTYCODE, sum(CASE EXPENDTYPE WHEN 1 THEN EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END )as 学习教育活动, sum(CASE EXPENDTYPE WHEN 2 THEN EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END )as 党内主题活动, sum(CASE EXPENDTYPE WHEN 3 THEN EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END )as 宣传活动, sum(CASE EXPENDTYPE WHEN 4 THEN EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END )as 会议活动, sum(CASE EXPENDTYPE WHEN 5 THEN EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END )as 党建日常工作, sum(CASE EXPENDTYPE WHEN 6 THEN EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END )as 走访慰问活动, sum(CASE EXPENDTYPE WHEN 7 THEN EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END )as 设备设施, sum(CASE EXPENDTYPE WHEN 8 THEN EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END )as 其他, sum(CASE EXPENDTYPE WHEN 20 THEN EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END )as 综合考评奖励, sum(CASE EXPENDTYPE WHEN 21 THEN EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END )as 七一表彰奖励, sum(CASE EXPENDTYPE WHEN 22 THEN EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END )as 创岗建区表彰奖励, sum(CASE EXPENDTYPE WHEN 23 THEN EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END )as 党建工作成果奖励, sum(CASE EXPENDTYPE WHEN 24 THEN EXPENDMONEY ELSE 0 END )as 主题竞赛活动奖励 from DJ_FUNDSUSE where extract(year from EXPENDTIME) = #{year} group by PARTYCODE )u on z.DZZDM=substr(u.PARTYCODE, 1, length(z.DZZDM)) group by z.DZZDM )ur on zz.DZZDM=ur.DZZDM where fb.ZZLB not in('500') and zz.DZZDM like '001091209%'
and zz.DZZDM like concat('%',#{partyCode},'%')
order by SUBSTR(zz.DZZDM,1,LENGTH(zz.DZZDM)-3),zz.DZZDM

select sum(ifnull(use.EXPENDMONEY,0))/10000 EXPENDMONEY, dc.DICKEY,dc.DICVALUE EXPENDTYPEName from CF_DICTIONARY dc left join ( select sum(ifnull(EXPENDMONEY,0)) EXPENDMONEY,EXPENDTYPE from DJ_FUNDSUSE where partyCode like concat('%',#{partyCode},'%') and extract(year from EXPENDTIME) = #{year} group by EXPENDTYPE ) use on use.EXPENDTYPE=dc.DICKEY where TO_NUMBER(DICNOTE) =#{expendscope} and dc.DICTYPEKEY='expendType' group by dc.DICVALUE,dc.DICKEY order by EXPENDMONEY desc
